newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwanda says border post with Zaire open 24 hours.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda says border post with Zaire open 24 hours.

text.p: Rwanda said on Saturday its border post with Zaire would be open around-the-clock to allow a human tide of refugees to pass.
Joseph Bideri, Rwanda's presidential spokesman, denied a report from the U.N. refugee agency (UNHCR) that the border was being closed to "control the influx".
"The border is not closed and it's not going to be closed. It will be open 24 hours a day," Bideri told Reuters by telephone from the Rwandan capital Kigali.
"I don't know where they got that report," he said.
UNHCR spokesman Francis Kpatinde, at the agency's Geneva headquarters, said earlier Rwanda would close the Petite Barriere border with Zaire at Goma-Gisenyi at 4 p.m. (1400 GMT).
Reuters journalists at the post confirmed it was still open several hours later, allowing hundreds of thousands of Rwandan refugees to cross back home.
